title: Predicting Early Unplanned Readmission to Critical Care Units Using Machine Learning and Metaheuristic Hyperparameter Optimization: Evidence from a Chilean Public Hospital.
summary: Five ML models assessed seven-day unplanned critical-care readmission in 371 patients, with nested stratified five-fold cross-validation and fold-contained preprocessing. Logistic regression had highest AUC (75.2%) and XGBoost 75.0%; case-enriched single-center data require recalibration and external validation.
ai_technology: 371 Chilean public-hospital ICU discharges with 41 readmissions; logistic regression, SVC, tree, random forest and XGBoost trained from transfer-time variables. Nested stratified five-fold CV; preprocessing fit within training folds. AUC 53.3–75.2%; LR highest 75.2%, XGBoost 75.0%; case-enriched cohort.
